item.title: New deadline for enrolment
item.description: For open-enrolment undergraduate programmes, enrolment will be possible until 12 March 2027. The deadline to take the TOLC test required for admission is 10 March 2027.%0A

item.title: Call for CELI exams - B1, B2 and C2 levels on 11-12 November 2026
item.description: The call is open to register for the CELI 2 B1, CELI 3 B2 and CELI 5 C2 exams scheduled on 11-12 November 2026.%0APLEASE NOTE: seats for the CELI 2 B1 and CELI 3 B2 exams are sold out.%0A%0A📄 Read the call for further details

item.title: Dual Career programme for student-athletes
item.description: The Dual Career programme is an initiative aimed at supporting high-level athletes in balancing their competitive sports commitments with their university career.%0A%0A▶️ Learn more on Unimi.it
